tools.name: top_issues
tools.description: Read a fresh, fully paginated Firebase ranking by occurrence count for one exact app URL. Returns counts, impacted users (null if unknown), links, interval, filters and ties. URL filters and profile thresholds/versions apply. No cache, stacks, publication or monitor changes; usable while monitoring. Check ok: true contains a ranking; false contains safe error.code/message, never partial or stale results. Query errors are inline, not in monitor status.

tools.name: retry
tools.description: Explicitly requeue blocked deliveries for one enabled subscription after the operator resolves the cause and authorizes retry. Requires a stopped monitor; preserves event and attachment IDs. Does not start polling or send messages.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect local monitor state and section counts. Select a section for paginated details, following nextOffset. Long diagnostic fields are marked previews. Does not contact the provider.

tools.name: start
tools.description: Start this project's monitor. It reads the provider and publishes observations to followed channels.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Request that this project's monitor stop. Already in-flight operations may finish; check status.

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Configure observation of one exact source in an existing channel. Requires a stopped monitor. Does not start polling or perform a review.

tools.name: unfollow
tools.description: Stop following an exact subscription ID and cancel its undelivered observations. Does not change the source or archive the channel.
